name: P21 (P021)
description: Lab-made pentapeptide built from part of ciliary neurotrophic factor (CNTF), a nerve-cell protein

note.text: All published work is in mice, rats or cells, almost all from the group that developed P021.

bullets: **Built from CNTF,** with a group added to slow breakdown, its developers say
**Crosses the blood–brain barrier** in aged rats
**Higher BDNF, lower GSK-3β** reported in Alzheimer's model mice
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Mouse, rat and cell studies only
Almost all from the developer's group
No human study published or registered

practical.routes: None studied in people; in feed (by mouth) in animals
practical.soldAs: “Research use only” labels; not for human use
practical.monitored: No human trials; memory and brain markers in animals
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status not stated

regulatory.text: Not approved; no product in Drugs@FDA
Not in the Oct 2026 peptide compounding policy

references: Alzheimers Res Ther, Baazaoui and Iqbal, P021 in 3xTg-AD mice, Jun 2017
Neurobiol Dis, Kazim et al., P021 in Alzheimer's model mice, Nov 2014
